summary.name: Kimi Code
summary.one_liner: Kimi Code is Moonshot AI's AI coding assistant, offered as a desktop app, terminal CLI, and IDE plugins, that can write, edit, and debug code and run commands.
use_cases: Implementing features and fixing bugs in a codebase
Searching and analyzing an unfamiliar codebase
Running tests, builds, and scripts and checking results
Coding from a terminal, desktop app, or IDE
summary.what_it_does: Kimi Code is an AI coding assistant that runs on the user's computer and is available as a desktop app, a terminal tool, and IDE plugins. According to the page, it can write and edit code, implement features, fix bugs, and refactor. It can search, read, and analyze existing code in a project. It can execute tests, builds, and scripts and then verify the results. It can also search the web or read web page content to look things up. The page says the K3 model is available on certain plans, and its meta description cites up to 1M context tokens.
notable: Runs on the user's computer and can execute commands, tests, and builds
Access to Kimi K3 model with up to 1M context tokens (per meta description)
Included as a membership benefit, with quota shared with Kimi membership (per listing)
caveats: Kimi Code is available only on specified plans; K3 is available only on certain plans and above, and the page does not name them
Access requires a Kimi subscription; the page does not list prices
